## Projects

- [RAG ChatBot](https://github.com/Mohak-talodhikar/RAG-ChatBot): Retrieval-augmented chatbot using FAISS vector search and Gemini for grounded, source-linked LLM answers.
- [Aura Finance](https://github.com/Mohak-talodhikar/Aura-Finance): Serverless personal finance tracker built with React, TypeScript, and Firebase.
- [Online Voting System](https://github.com/Mohak-talodhikar/Online-voting-system): Serverless voting application on AWS.
